How do I post a car?
From the Add tab in the bottom bar, or from "Sell a car" on the profile page. Fill in the car details, add photos, then publish.
How do I save a car?
Tap the save icon on the car card so it appears under "Saved" on the profile page.
How do I contact the seller?
Open the car page and use the WhatsApp or call button with the seller's number, or send an offer from the ad page. To contact the seller: open the car page and use the WhatsApp or call button.
How do I report a violating ad?
Open the car page and tap "Report ad" at the bottom, then pick a reason. To report an ad: open the car page then "Report ad".
My car has not appeared after publishing?
The ad needs review before it appears. Track your ads from "My ads". To follow up and edit your ads: open "My ads" from the profile page.
For an issue with your account or the app: use "Report a problem" or "Contact support" below.
Where do I find my ads?
On the profile page pick "My ads" to see everything you posted, then edit or delete it.
How do I send a message?
Open your messages inside the app to talk directly.
